# StatusPanel

A black HUD panel (surface-inverse, chamfer-16) for live telemetry: Space Grotesk tabular numbers, mono labels, 4px meters.

`PhantomPortals.StatusPanel` · Command Center

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.StatusPanel title="…" metrics={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.StatusPanel" title="…" metrics="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Black HUD telemetry panel. Show only real readings; use value "Unavailable" when a source is missing.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `metrics` * | `Metric[]` |  |

### Metric

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `value` * | `string; /** 0–100 meter fill; omit for no meter. */` |  |
| `percent` | `number; /** Over threshold: crimson meter — also say so in the label. */` |  |
| `hot` | `boolean` |  |
